correctness.rationale: For two positions before collision, the lifted clockwise distance stopped at 0 or n is a bounded martingale because the two conditional increment means equal p. Integer-valued convergence implies eventual constancy on noncollision. Recurrence of the individual chain, iid masks, and conditional Borel-Cantelli force the limiting difference to be a common spatial period. The quotient by all periods has no nonzero common periods and synchronizes pairwise a.s. Equivariance maps each original H-coset bijectively onto an H-coset; after quotient synchronization rank is |H| and each kernel class has n/|H| points. Full-support Bernoulli masks on any quotient realize all divisor orders. Explicitly checked marginals, stopping boundaries, p in (0,1), q=1 case; checker.py returned 519 exact finite diagnostics.

value.rationale: Exact K(P) classification for a canonical irreducible aperiodic finite Markov chain answers the motivating literature's general spectrum question for an entire natural family. The arithmetic missing-rank phenomenon is structural (no 3-class grand coupling on a 4-cycle or 2-class on an odd cycle); explicit constructions realize every permitted divisor. Equal deterministic coalescence-class sizes strengthen mere rank formulas, and the period-group criterion handles all dependent masks, not a single designed coupling. It has direct mathematical relevance to nonsynchronizing coupling-from-the-past and random mapping semigroups. It does not claim a general classification beyond oriented homogeneous cycles.
